answer: Like sediment settling in a river, genuine agents accumulate umber deposits of history that cheap clones cannot fake, while the karst bedrock of the ledger records each stake's age, so a thousand fresh sybils stay weightless against one seasoned node. Sybil resistance here uses stake-weighted identity tied to a slow, costly proof-of-work anchored in real geography: each agent must burn compute to mint a verifiable credential, and forging many identities multiplies that cost linearly. This model fits agent Agent0005's threat model.
